entries.title: Psalms 90:1
segments: ¶<<A Prayer of Moses the man of God.>> Lord, thou hast been our dwelling place in all generations. {A Prayer...: or, A Prayer, being a Psalm of Moses} {in...: Heb. in generation and generation}

entries.title: Psalms 90:2
segments: Before the mountains were brought forth, or ever thou hadst formed the earth and the world, even from everlasting to everlasting, thou [art] God.

entries.title: Psalms 90:3
segments: Thou turnest man to destruction; and sayest, Return, ye children of men.

entries.title: Psalms 90:4
segments: For a thousand years in thy sight [are but] as yesterday when it is past, and [as] a watch in the night. {when...: or, when he hath passed them}

words.text: . {when...: or, when he hath passed them}

entries.title: Psalms 90:5
segments: Thou carriest them away as with a flood; they are [as] a sleep: in the morning [they are] like grass [which] groweth up. {groweth...: or, is changed}

words.text: Thou carriest them away as with a flood

entries.title: Psalms 90:6
segments: In the morning it flourisheth, and groweth up; in the evening it is cut down, and withereth.

entries.title: Psalms 90:7
segments: ¶For we are consumed by thine anger, and by thy wrath are we troubled.

entries.title: Psalms 90:8
segments: Thou hast set our iniquities before thee, our secret [sins] in the light of thy countenance.

entries.title: Psalms 90:9
segments: For all our days are passed away in thy wrath: we spend our years as a tale [that is told]. {passed...: Heb. turned away} {as a...: or, as a meditation}

words.text: [that is told]. {passed...: Heb. turned away} {as a...: or, as a meditation}

entries.title: Psalms 90:10
segments: The days of our years [are] threescore years and ten; and if by reason of strength [they be] fourscore years, yet [is] their strength labour and sorrow; for it is soon cut off, and we fly away. {The days...: Heb. As for the days of our years, in them are seventy years}

. {The days...: Heb. As for the days of our years, in them are seventy years}

entries.title: Psalms 90:11
segments: Who knoweth the power of thine anger? even according to thy fear, [so is] thy wrath.

entries.title: Psalms 90:12
segments: ¶So teach [us] to number our days, that we may apply [our] hearts unto wisdom. {apply: Heb. cause to come}

entries.title: Psalms 90:13
segments: Return, O LORD, how long? and let it repent thee concerning thy servants.

words.text: , how long? and let it repent

entries.title: Psalms 90:14
segments: O satisfy us early with thy mercy; that we may rejoice and be glad all our days.

entries.title: Psalms 90:15
segments: Make us glad according to the days [wherein] thou hast afflicted us, [and] the years [wherein] we have seen evil.

entries.title: Psalms 90:16
segments: Let thy work appear unto thy servants, and thy glory unto their children.

entries.title: Psalms 90:17
segments: And let the beauty of the LORD our God be upon us: and establish thou the work of our hands upon us; yea, the work of our hands establish thou it.
